### Jesus Will Finish the Mission
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/jesus-will-finish-the-mission
Passage: Matthew 24:14
Points:
- Jesus' declaration is not merely a task to attempt, but an absolute guarantee of global proclamation.
- Christ possesses complete sovereignty over history, ensuring that his church will not fail its mission.
- Biblical nations refer not to modern nation-states, but to distinct ethnic and linguistic people groups.
- Because the ultimate triumph of world evangelization is certain, Christians can pray, give, and go with unshakable confidence.

### The Worldwide Gospel
Author: Jerry Bridges
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/worldwide-gospel
Passage: Matthew 24:14
Points:
- Christ’s promise of universal proclamation continues God's ancient covenant pledge to bless every family on earth.
- Scripture envisions the final success of the gospel as an accomplished reality before the throne of God.
- Formidable religious and political barriers still leave large portions of the world unevangelized.
- Beyond supporting missionaries financially, every believer is urged to plead daily with God to fulfill His promise.
